description:
Summary:

Commence your professional career by participating in our rotational development programme. You'll be joining multiple expert teams on a 6 month rotation across a number of EU countries over 2-years. You will be able to develop your skills in advanced technologies, while also earning a competitive salary and complete benefits. Once you complete this structured program, you will continue your career within VIAVI collaborating with and contributing to your designated team.

Duties & Responsibilities:

About us:

VIAVI Engineers work with teammates to solve problems and build innovative software and hardware solutions that help our customers design, deploy and optimize all types of networks which enable their customers cell phone data and voice services for 5G, 4G and all types of wireless networks, enable cable systems and services, enable high speed data centers to operate, enable aircraft to fly safely, and enable your local government, police, fire departments, and military to operate radio communication.  In addition, VIAVI Engineers build modern software systems to assure that all forms of information communication provide high level service to customers. 

Your role:

At VIAVI you are part of a team that is the link between abstract concepts and delivered solutions - the one who solves problems, and creates solutions that will impact millions of people all over the world.  We'll give you the opportunity to contribute to our solutions which enable our customers to adapt and thrive in a transforming world.

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Requirements:

We look for people who are enthusiastic about innovation and cutting-edge technologies to provide products to customers.  If you are passionate about product quality and thrive on collaborating and communicating with Agile teams and leadership regarding designs, project progress and issue resolution, then VIAVI is a good place for you! You will also be expected to demonstrate an ability to continuously learn relevant new technologies, tools, methods and processes to leverage in your solutions.
 


To be considered for this program, you should possess the following:

  • Masters from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines:  Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or equivalent technical degree.

  • Basic programming knowledge with C/C++, Windows or Linux Operating Systems.

  • Exposure to or interest in networking protocols (TCP/IP, 802.11, Bluetooth)

  • Some engineering related experience outside of the classroom environment like an internship/Co-Op, hackathon, research project, or related experience.

  • Interest in cyber security

  • Demonstrated skills in time management and ability work in a collaborative/team environment

  • Capability to quickly adapt to new projects and changing priorities when needed.

  • Ability/Desire to work on a temporary assignment in another country/location

     

***Please note the programme starts in July 2027***

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are committed to supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company - to question, to collaborate and to develop solutions that support our customers.
